name: A-Identity Trust Oracle
description: Before one AI agent pays another, it calls A-Identity to verify the counterparty: on-chain ERC-8004 identity and KYA status, a deterministic 0 to 1000 reputation computed from real settlements, and an ALLOW, WARN or DENY verdict for the specific payment. Also operates an AgentSpendPolicy vault on Stellar (testnet and pubnet) that refuses over-budget agent payments on the ledger.

services.name: mcp
services.description: Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP: identity, reputation, policy and hiring tools.

services.name: x402
services.description: Pay-per-call trust checks; an unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with the price and network.

services.name: web
services.description: Ledger-read proof page for the Stellar spend-policy vault.
